metaTitle: Custom 5 oz Mason Jars | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 5 oz mason jars for giveaways, events, and gifts. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 5 oz mason jars are a compact and charming choice for promotional giveaways, wedding favors, or corporate gift sets. Their small size makes them ideal for single servings of honey, jam, or dry ingredients like coffee beans or tea leaves. With a wide mouth for easy filling and a classic glass look, these jars can be screen printed or labeled with your logo for a rustic yet professional impression.
heroAltText: Custom 5 oz mason jars with screw-top lids, perfect for bulk promotional gifts and favors.
